name: Busuu
tagline: Busuu is a language learning app that combines AI-driven lessons with real corrections from native speakers around the world. Its adaptive curriculum covers speaking, writing, grammar, and vocabulary, with a certification programme recognised by McGill University. The community feedback loop makes it one of the few apps where you practise with humans, not just bots.
